prepare_sample: prepare a packed FrameSequence with a single image, depth, camera, and object annotations from dataset chunk data
parse_chunk_cameras: parse per-image camera parameters from JSON data into a dictionary of PinholePlaneCameraModel objects
load_chunk_cameras: load per-image camera parameters from a JSON file into a dictionary of PinholePlaneCameraModel objects
parse_chunk_gts: parse ground truth object annotations from JSON data into a dictionary of ObjectAnnotation lists
construct_center_crop_camera: construct a virtual camera model and crop box for center-cropping an image viewport to a specified size
